verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs describe sandboxes driven from its SDK, REST API and CLI. Sandboxes can be deployed from images "in seconds", resume from standby in under 25ms, and are then operated via SDK for processes and files. Missing for 10: an explicit single create-call example showing provisioning, documentation of the sandbox isolation boundary (e.g. VM/microVM), cold-start timing for brand-new sandboxes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed claims.
